# Android Claude Code Skills

> Reusable Android development skills for AI coding assistants.
> Compatible with Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor.

## Skills

- [Android Translation Sync](skills/android-translation-sync/SKILL.md): Sync Android strings.xml translations from Excel spreadsheets across all language variants.
- [Android Change Review](skills/android-change-review/SKILL.md): Review staged git changes or commits for Android crash risks, boundary conditions, and regressions.
- [APK Analyzer](skills/apk-analyzer/SKILL.md): Parse and audit Android APK files — extract metadata, classify permissions by risk, verify signatures, detect SDKs, produce security report.

## Platform Integration

- [Claude Code](CLAUDE.md): Install via `/plugin marketplace add aihip/android-claude-code-skills`
- [OpenAI Codex](AGENTS.md): Copy skills to `~/.agents/skills/` or `.agents/skills/`
- [Gemini CLI](GEMINI.md): Import via `@path/to/gemini-rules/*.md` in `GEMINI.md`
- [Cursor](cursor-rules/): Copy `.mdc` files to `.cursor/rules/`
